create_policy: create a new policy with a name, description, and guardrails list via POST /policies
list_policies: list all policies from the database, optionally filtered by version status
get_policy: get a single policy by its ID from the database
update_policy: update an existing draft policy's fields like description or guardrails
delete_policy: delete a policy version by its ID from the database
list_policy_versions: list all versions of a policy by name ordered by version number descending
create_policy_version: create a new draft version of a policy copying from a source policy
update_policy_version_status: update a policy version's status between draft, published, and production
compare_policy_versions: compare two policy versions by their IDs to see differences
delete_all_policy_versions: delete all versions of a policy by name from the database
get_resolved_guardrails: get the resolved guardrails for a policy including inherited guardrails
test_pipeline: test a guardrail pipeline with sample messages and return step-by-step results
list_policy_attachments: list all policy attachments from the database
create_policy_attachment: create a new policy attachment linking a policy to teams, keys, or models
get_policy_attachment: get a single policy attachment by its ID
delete_policy_attachment: delete a policy attachment by its ID from the database
